results.content: The analyzed data include information about pipe joints and appurtenances provided by ILI data and/or pipeline operator documentation, as well as pipe anomaly characteristics such as: anomaly classification, depth, length, width, relative location to pipe wall, and anomaly origin (e.g., mill, construction, corrosion). Incorporating ILI signal data review in the asset integrity management process helps operators react to potential integrity threats and monitor critical pipeline segments for potential emerging threats. Extreme value analysis (EVA) was applied to estimate the maximum external corrosion depths and the associated failure pressure ratios (FPRs) of remnants, utilizing ILI and excavation data from the inspected portions of pipelines to inform predictions. The data they provide is crucial for monitoring pipe movement, managing geohazards, and broader strain-based integrity management of pipelines, including other threats such as corrosion, cracks, and geometry features. + Increased sensitivity of ILI sensors creates much more data that needs to be aligned to the pipeline centerline and pipeline girth welds to perform corrosion growth, anomaly analysis, and other pipeline integrity management operations and procedures.

results.title: What do you believe is true though you can't prove it?
results.content: I believe that human talents are based on distinct patterns of brain connectivity. Most cognitive scientists believe that consciousness is a phenomenon that emerges from the complex interaction of decidedly nonconscious parts (neurons), but even when we finally understand the nature of that complex interaction, we still won't be able to prove that it produces the phenomenon in question. I mean that I am convinced that there is a consistent way of thinking about nature, that makes no use of the notions of space and time at the fundamental level. I believe, but cannot prove, that memory is inherent in nature. Just making the right proteins at the right times cannot explain such structures without many other forces coming into play, including the organizing activity of cell membranes and microtubules. But whatever the details of the models, I believe that the natural selection of habits will play an essential part in any integrated theory of evolution, including not just biological evolution, but also physical, chemical, cosmic, social, mental and cultural evolution.

results.content: 🌏 As part of the lead-up to the CTTU & TBM DiGs 2026 Joint International Conferences, we are proud to introduce a free-to-enter event UIDC 2026 – a global challenge bringing together students and early-career professionals to tackle key issues in underground infrastructure through digitalisation, AI, and sustainability. 🧠 Challenge Themes Include: 3D Modelling of TBM Advancement AI-based Geological Forecasting Tunnel Monitoring & Maintenance Carbon and Sustainability Assessment Emerging Topics (custom-defined by participants) 🎥 In-Person & Online (Hybrid Participation Available) UIDC 2026 welcomes both on-site and virtual participants to maximise global accessibility and collaboration. On 8 October 2025 bridgeUkraine, together with The Bartlett School of Sustainable Construction UCL and State Enterprise "National Institute for Development Infrastructure", delivered the online session “Strategic Dialogue: Digital Twins, LCCM and Sustainable Infrastructure Reconstruction.” 📽️ To see the recorded CPD session about Digital Twins: https://lnkd.in/e97X7Mfb The discussion highlighted how Digital Twins and life-cycle cost management help optimise CAPEX/OPEX, improve risk control via LiDAR and sensors, and align with international standards (Gemini Principles).
